styleSelection.reason: Sunlit stone planes and cool connected shadows carry the Gothic building; fine sepia lines explain only roof junctions, arches and window divisions.

families.referenceCue: Pale blue variegated sky and luminous cloud gaps: one connected light wash, overlapping while open, with no later nested sky patches; dry roof boundaries.
Warm ochre and raw-sienna gable facing the light. Broad luminous stone foundation, dry shaped mid planes, sparse irregular ashlar hints; pale window surrounds survive.
Left wing and tall chimney have cool muted stone shadow planes. Connected blue and raw-sienna dry glazes cross masonry, eaves and openings; keep the tall chimney silhouette.
Right chimney, receding wing and lower projecting bay: dry angular roof planes, broad pale walls, coherent cast shadows under cornices; dark window recesses last.
Yellow-green connected canopy against warm stone, light green foundation and darker connected groups on dry paper. Preserve irregular wall gaps; trunk and a few crisp leaf edges last.
Muted ivy and small left trees merge into the shaded base: connected olive wash and dry shadow groups, very little line or leaf detail.
Thin ground strip and small pedestrians establish scale. Pale pavement foundation, connected cool ground shadow, a few small dry dark accents; no grass-like stippling.
